checks.finding: design.md Architecture, Data Plan and authorization/execution sections justify separate provider state, versioned dispatch, exact AWS Change Set execution and Azure preview refresh. ADR 0036 Alternatives explains rejection of a generic engine, unrestricted credentials and deployment-success-as-health.
design.md Open Questions assigns environment-owner and development-environment-owner roles to OQ-001/002, explicitly states implementation blocking status, and supplies concrete Resolution Paths.

design.md Assumptions uses the GitHub Actions boundary explicitly selected in requirements.md Assumptions. Protected environments and exclusive write ownership are enforceable deployment prerequisites, not presumed local guarantees; lifecycle, Risks and infra-spec.md explicitly disclose external-writer and IAM limitations.

design.md Constraint Compliance addresses thin integration, single execution ownership, legacy compatibility, authorization, genuine verification, historical preservation, region/account policy, evidence residency/retention, backup/budget and brownfield/import restrictions. Detailed lifecycle and release sections preserve the remaining operational constraints. No contradictory layer override found.
No performance requirements found in requirements.md. infra-spec.md additionally requires bounded polling deadlines and deterministic termination tests without asserting an application SLA.

design.md Deployment / CI Plan specifies installed plugins, reviewable GitHub workflow/IAM templates, credential-free deterministic CI and opt-in protected sandbox jobs. infra-spec.md CI/CD Sequence orders validation, prepare approval, preview, apply approval, locking, execution and observation. No database migration or incremental production rollout is introduced.

design.md Data Plan introduces additive file-based artifacts and explicit cloud verification version/profile dispatch, not database table or column changes. Existing-version behavior and historical evidence remain unchanged; unknown cloud fields fail closed.

design.md External Integration Inventory identifies GitHub REST 2022-11-28, ARM 2025-04-01, CloudFormation 2010-05-15, authoring toolchains, pinned upstream skills and optional MCP, with purposes and fail-closed incompatibility behavior. Exact CLI patches must be locked before first build; ambiguous approvals and reruns require a fresh dispatch.

design.md routing, provider execution, contracts, verification, #423 repair, public invocation and documentation/release sections cover REQ-001–014 and the user stories. Shared validation remains narrow; unsupported owners, imports, production provisioning and generic cross-cloud execution remain excluded. Frontend and design-system surfaces are explicitly unchanged.

design.md Test Strategy and Unit and Integration Boundaries name four deterministic test entry points, TEST-004–010 adversarial authorization/integrity/recovery checks, isolated verify-codex evidence and separately authorized live sandbox trials. Mandatory dependency-failure and NO_CHANGE scenarios explicitly assert zero forbidden submissions; fixture evidence cannot establish live IAM enforcement.
